reviews.name: Deon W.
reviews.text: Fantastic company. Juan came to my mother's house which was over an hour away from him. He looked at the complete sprinkler system that was already existing but not in use. He determined he could reuse what was existing and just make repairs. Within 2 days the sprinkler system was brought back to life tested and verified. My mother was happy, She has her sprinkler system back. I then had him come to my house because I had a bunch of dead spots in my grass, he changed the orientation of my sprinkler heads and fixed all my issues. He did this as a courtesy even though we paid him but I appreciate his work ethic and his pride in the work he does. Definitely 10 out of 10.
